name: @privacy-wallet/server-kit
description: What the API and the relayer share (spec v2.0 §15, doc §67–§68): the typed logger (one JSON line per event, keys ⊆ at, level, event, operationId, provider, state, errorClass, network — an address, a hash or an amount is redacted, never written), the token-bucket rate limiter (in memory, keyed by the socket's address, never logged), the security headers and the CORS allowlist. No dependencies.
